messages:
emma: Heads up  had a weird trip for the EU offsite. My carry-on was pickpocketed on the train (receipts and wallet gone). I bought emergency replacements (toothbrush, phone charger, basic clothes) and I also paid my portion of a multiride rail ticket that our team booked on one card. What's needed to get reimbursed? cc @travel-admin :frowning:

jorge: Oof sorry that happened. For the split rail ticket: we all agreed to split at checkout and the card says "TEAM RAIL BOOKING" with one total charge. I only have a screenshot of my share from our group spreadsheet and the e-ticket PDF shows all passengers. How to submit?

travel-admin: First, sorry about the theft. Policy: for lost receipts due to theft we accept a police report or official lost-property report + card statement showing the charge + any available vendor doc (e-ticket/invoice). For emergency purchases under $75 each, a photo of the item + card statement is acceptable; over $75 needs a receipt or manager sign-off if receipt is missing.

travel-admin: For multi-passenger rail bookings:
- Preferred: e-ticket or vendor invoice listing each passenger and fare split.
- If vendor provided only a single invoice, each traveler should submit their expense with: their name on the e-ticket (passenger list) + card statement showing the group charge + a short note saying "split with X; share amount $Y" and manager approval.
- If you paid another teammate back in cash, that personal reimbursement is not company expense. The company reimburses only the business-eligible portion charged on a card.

people-ops: Checklist for theft/lost receipt cases (what to upload):
```
- Police report or vendor lost-property report (if available)
- Card/bank statement line showing the charge(s) (photo ok)
- E-ticket / vendor invoice / booking confirmation (showing passenger names if team booking)
- Photos of emergency purchase items (for <$75 items) + card txn
- Expense note: brief timeline + "receipts lost due to pickpocketing"
- Manager acknowledgement in expense comments (for refunds >$75 without receipt)
```

emma: I filed a police report at the station and attached the PDF. I also have copies of the e-ticket and the card statement but no vendor invoice splitting fares. I paid €120 as my share (I only have the group total on the card). Manager wants quick turnaround for payroll. Will this clear?

manager-suzanne: I saw the police report and Emma's note. I approve reimbursing up to €150 for emergency clothing/essentials with receipts where possible; for missing receipts I approve up to €100 with police report and card txn. For the rail split, I confirm Emma's share is €120 per our team sheet. I'll leave a comment on the expense to approve.

travel-admin: Great. Finance will need the manager approval attached to the expense. For the rail: include the e-ticket passenger list + group card statement + manager comment stating the agreed split. We'll clear the reimbursement as long as documentation matches the manager's note.

finance-bot: Reminder  items > $75 normally require a vendor receipt. In theft cases, police report + manager approval can substitute. Currency: keep original EUR amounts and include a conversion note screenshot if you want USD equivalent. Finance will use corporate FX policy date for our internal records.

jorge: Quick Q: My phone charger purchase was €25 but the store gave no receipt (cash). I have a photo of the item and the bank withdrawal for the day. Is that OK?

people-ops: Cash purchases without receipts are risky. For small emergency items (<$50) we accept a photo + bank withdrawal proof + police report if applicable. Add a very brief note: "cash emergency purchase due to pickpocketing; no merchant receipt available." Manager sign-off recommended.

travel-admin: Edge case: if the rail operator issues VAT invoices and you need VAT reclaim for a business fare, we require the official VAT invoice with tax ID. If you only have an e-ticket, VAT reclaim may not be possible. Attach any VAT-documentation you get; travel-admin can escalate for VAT invoices on your behalf.

emma: Thanks. I'll upload the police report, e-ticket, card stmt, and photos. Also adding manager approval. For the emergency clothing I bought two items (~€85 total)  I have only card txn for the store but they said printer broken. Manager approved the €85. Will finance accept the card txn + manager note?

finance-bot: In that scenario finance accepts the card txn + manager approval as long as manager explicitly approves the missing receipt. We'll mark the line as "approved: missing receipt due to theft" and process. If the merchant later provides a receipt or refund, finance will reconcile.

travel-admin: Final note: if any refunds happen (e.g., someone refunded the group ticket or vendor issues credit), alert finance immediately and attach refund proof. Also keep any email threads with the vendor; they help with audits. :memo:

emma: Really appreciate the fast responses. Uploading now. Thanks all. :heart:

jorge: Saved for others  if receipts are stolen, get a police report ASAP and upload everything to the expense. That avoided a big delay for Emma. :thumbsup:
